evidence: Business listings at 10951 W Emerald St show ATS Inland NW (HVAC/building automation contractor), Romar Electric and Idaho Inflatables (rental), in a West Boise industrial/flex corridor; no building page found.
OfficeSpace.com and Showcase list 6660 Broughton Ave as a 1979 one-story industrial/cold-storage building with 20 dock doors and 30' clear.
CityFeet lists 1812 Garden Spring Dr, Dallas 75253 as a ~12,000 SF warehouse for sale at $2,000,000.

390 E Corporate Dr is the 17,004 SF two-story MBI Corporate Building, multi-tenant office plus some warehouse space; tenants are mostly office/service suites (consulting, home care, weight loss, business incubator) with one refinishing shop.
Wooten Plaza at 1710 Wooten Park Dr is a 1967 two-story 8-unit apartment building, listed on LoopNet as Multifamily for sale and on apartment sites.
Zillow, Redfin, Apartments.com and an MLS listing describe 74 W Moler St as an 8-unit multifamily building (built 1960) listed for sale at $775,000.
LoopNet lists 4340 N Las Vegas Blvd as the 50-unit Nellis Gate(s) Apartments built 2002; Clark County business license shows NELLIS GATES APTS at this address.
TDLR filings show 9900 Spectrum Dr as LegalZoom's Austin office building (interior renovation, cafe), sold in 2025 as an office building for about $38M.

Crexi listing for 7001 Lyons Ave (9,834 SF, 1950, vacant, 18' ceilings, fenced yard) is tagged Retail/Industrial (grocery store/distribution) but its marketing copy pitches it for commercial, warehousing or light industrial use; crexi.com itself was blocked for direct fetch, so this rests on search snippets.
Multiple store directories (Yelp, Yellow Pages, Foursquare) list an Ashley HomeStore furniture store at 9200 W Sahara Ave.
LoopNet and Showcase list 5324-5338 N 7th Ave as a small shopping center (5,245 SF, built 1959) with tenants like Junior's Barber Parlor at 5324/5336.
Hanley Investment Group sale report identifies 10040-10064 Bruceville Rd as The Shops at Laguna Reserve, a 33,308 SF retail center (Starbucks, Bank of America, Round Table, pet hospital).
Crexi identifies 7121 W US Hwy 90 as Gateway Plaza, a 179,327 SF shopping center (Dollar General, Dollar Tree); tenants Music Connection and Al's Hobbies are in the same strip mall.
Parcel and LoopNet records for 3511 (3507-3511) Houston Ave show a 1930 store building, land use Storebuilding, about 13,000 SF retail property.
Directory listings place the Hobby Lobby store at 625 N Stephanie St in the Whitney Ranch/Stephanie Street Power Center shopping center.
